title: South African Climate Risk Tool overview (SARVA)

geographic_coverage.label: South Africa; the portal describes multiple products with differing resolution

reuse.review_notes: This is a source-discovery page. Review terms for the specific climate tool and underlying data before downloading, adapting, or redistributing content.

limitations: The SARVA homepage describes a climate-risk product but this catalogue record is not the underlying gridded dataset.
A tool description does not establish an API, a downloadable file, the current model version, or rights to redistribute source data.

title: Climate Change Projections

geographic_coverage.label: South Africa; climate change maps described as national

reuse.review_notes: This page links to different sources and map products. No dataset-specific reuse license, direct data URL, or download receipt has been verified.

limitations: The page describes a comparison between a 1971-2000 baseline and 2021-2050 projections; one broad coverage window is not a continuous observation period.
The page does not establish the selected map's metric grid resolution or local street-level accuracy.
The described maps use a median of six dynamically downscaled GCMs and RCP 4.5/RCP 8.5; details must be confirmed for any downloaded product.

title: GreenBook MetroView Profiles

geographic_coverage.label: Selected South African metropolitan municipalities; profile detail reported up to ward level

reuse.review_notes: The landing page links to interactive profiles. Review the individual profile's data/export terms and citation requirements before copying or redistributing assets.

limitations: The page states that risk profile information is available up to ward level; ward-level administrative detail is not a uniform metric grid size.
A web profile does not by itself establish an available public API or the licensing of its underlying map layers.
Current and 2050 profile indicators remain source-reported until the underlying methods, versions and data are reviewed.

title: GreenBook Planning Support: Reports, Plans and Maps & Data Packages

geographic_coverage.label: Municipal support resources across South Africa; individual package coverage varies

reuse.review_notes: This page lists reports, adaptation plans, and data packages. Availability and terms must be checked for the specific municipality and asset.

limitations: The visible page layout does not conclusively establish whether a separate downloadable Johannesburg data package is available.
The index and the MetroView profile page serve different purposes; their content should not be treated as interchangeable.
This catalog listing is not proof of reuse permission, download availability, or service/API access.
